meaning: Retry exceeded: flame never sensed after 3 ignition tries in one call for heat. One-hour lockout.
causes: Gas valve switch OFF, no voltage to gas valve, or debris in gas valve
Inlet gas pressure too high or below nameplate minimum
Dirty flame sensor, poor grounding, sensor location or wire connections
diySteps: Make sure other gas appliances in the home work, to confirm gas supply
Make sure the gas valve switch is ON
Technician: measure inlet and manifold gas pressure (manifold ~1.7" WC natural gas, ~6.0" WC LP)
Technician: check igniter position, burners and flame current (typical 0.75-3.0 microamps)
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if gas supply is confirmed and the lockout repeats.
